title: Builders in Mogappair: Rebuilding 1980s Houses in a Planned Layout

seo.metaTitle: Builders in Mogappair | Old House Rebuilds | Hunter Property
seo.metaDescription: Rebuilding a 1980s house in Mogappair? We read the old structure, work out what current rules let you build and quote demolition and foundations separately.

excerpt: Mogappair’s planned layout is full of 1980s houses reaching rebuild age. This guide covers the load-bearing question, what the layout makes easier, the rebuild line items and the extra area a rebuild can gain.
faqTitle: Rebuilding in Mogappair: questions owners ask

faqs.question: What do your house construction packages cost in Mogappair?
faqs.answer: Our packages are priced per sq ft of built-up area: Basic ₹2,199, Standard ₹2,399, Premium ₹2,699 and Ultra Luxury ₹3,199. Approvals, soil test, compound wall, sump and interiors are quoted separately. Demolition and debris disposal are added on top. Most Mogappair streets take a transit mixer, so there is usually no access premium.

faqs.question: Does the planned layout make building in Mogappair easier?
faqs.answer: Yes. Plots are regular, most roads take a transit mixer and setback and coverage rules are applied consistently because the layout was sanctioned as a whole, so drawings rarely hit surprises at submission.

faqs.question: Can a rebuild give me more house on the same Mogappair plot?
faqs.answer: Often. Setback, coverage and floor space rules have changed since the 1980s, and a plot carrying a modest single-storey house may permit considerably more built-up area today. We work out the permissible envelope before you decide.

faqs.question: What do you check on the first visit to an old Mogappair house?
faqs.answer: What is holding it up. Many houses of that era are load-bearing masonry, so the first visit is a structural read rather than a design conversation, because the structure decides what is possible and what it costs.

faqs.question: How do you handle neighbours during a Mogappair rebuild?
faqs.answer: With occupied houses on either side, dust control and working hours become real constraints, and electricity, water and sewerage each need disconnecting on their own timeline. Our programme allows for all of it.
